coverage.implementationEvidence: Canonical and packaged KinPlay content now carry the exact I Spy summary; the safety decision matrix and regression checks were synchronized.
FeedbackStore now selects ACTION_SEND for one attachment and ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE for multiple attachments; attachment handoff tests cover the extras.
AppSettings contains six named color themes including Lavender; settings persistence and palette acceptance tests were updated.
Level 1 ContentCard keeps the independent favorite control while making the title the details-navigation target.
The owner-supplied prompt manifest remains reference-only and verbatim; runtime retains the 20 previously owner-supplied prompts separately from assistant-created entries.
washable_coloring_together is absent from active canonical/runtime content and the derived lock/safety matrices; active-content regression expectations were updated.
Format-group metadata, parsing, grouping helpers, and grouped Level 1 presentation were added without deleting recognizable activity identities.
The Settings surface no longer exposes launcher selection; stable legacy launcher wire handling remains internal for persisted-preference compatibility.
Lavender completes the six-theme set and Settings renders theme choices in the three-column layout with updated tests.
All 120 Charades cards now carry reviewed image-resource metadata and accessible prompt-specific alt text; three generated category masters are packaged and byte-checked.
The unavailable tester JPEG was not ingested or copied; Gemini-generated category masters were produced from the Charades prompt order and integrated as project resources.
The generic Prepare/Play/Share guide was removed from the targeted detail/session surfaces; the specific Tiny Monster guide remains.
Would You Rather prompts were rewritten into concise read-aloud text and synchronized across canonical, packaged, and review-export representations.
Each of the four categories contains exactly 40 prompts; count reduction retained the 20 protected runtime owner entries and removed only eligible assistant-created entries.
The recorded conservative safety boundary permits only non-crass gross humor in the approved category and retains prohibited-material guards; no unverified age-10+ relaxation is claimed.
Level 1 cards are grouped by format, non-expandable, metadata-light, title-navigable, and retain favorite behavior; hierarchy regression tests were updated.
